ios.desc:
Are you struggling with math or science homework? Want to prepare smarter for your exams? Welcome to Socratic Owl – your AI-powered study buddy that makes learning fast, easy, and stress-free.


Whether it’s complex math problems or tough science concepts, Socratic Owl gives you instant, step-by-step solutions. Just snap a photo or type your question – and get clear answers in seconds!

Much more than just a problem solver.

---

Key Features:

• Scan to Solve – Snap a photo of your question and receive step-by-step solutions  
• Type to Answer – Prefer typing? Enter your question manually and get detailed help  
• Ad-Free Learning – Study without interruptions from ads  
• All Subjects Covered – Math, science, and more  
• 24/7 Access – Your personal AI tutor anytime, anywhere

Note: All features require a subscription. A free trial may be available; pricing and terms are shown in-app. Subscriptions auto-renew unless cancelled.
---

Why Choose Socratic Owl?

• Step-by-Step Explanations – Understand every part of the solution  
• Simple One-Page Interface – Fast and easy to use  
• Powered by AI – Smarter help for better understanding

---

How It Works:

1. Capture or Type – Take a photo or type your question  
2. Get Instant Solutions – Watch AI break down the problem step-by-step  
3. Learn Effortlessly – Perfect for homework or exam prep

---

Download Socratic Owl now and unlock your full potential!

Subscription Info:  
Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions auto-renew unless turned off in Account Settings at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime via iTunes.


Privacy Policy: https://lumination.ai/privacy-policy-for-socratic-owl 
Terms of Use: https://lumination.ai/terms-and-conditions-for-socratic-owl
